title: Terms of the Standing Instruction to Draft Your Auto Loan Installment
content:
Where you ask the bank to draft your installment automatically, the bank debits a Piedmont Crescent checking account for the monthly installment on each due date of your loan in the Auto Loans line.

**The account it is drafted from.** The account named must be a checking account of yours, in active status at the time the instruction is put in place.

**Your instruction.** Putting the instruction in place and withdrawing it are your own instructions about your own funds. Your loan must be active or delinquent at the time.

**Withdrawn basis.** The basis by which the automatic-payment reduction was added to your rate from the next installment falling due at least 5 calendar days after you enrolled, and came off on the same schedule when you withdrew the instruction, is **no longer in force**. The rate your loan carries once the instruction changes is settled on the basis now in force for Auto Loans.

**What a change of rate does to your installment.** A change in the rate on your loan does not change the monthly installment. It changes how each installment divides between interest and principal, and therefore what remains to be paid in the final installment.

**A draft that is returned.** Where a drafted payment is returned unpaid, it is handled as a returned payment, and the standing instruction remains in place.

## How the account test and the installment read

The account named is tested when the instruction is put in place, and the record of that account is what settles it. An account closed after the instruction was put in place does not retrospectively unmake the instruction, and an account you tell the bank about but which the bank's record shows as other than active cannot be named.

Because the monthly installment does not move with the rate, the effect of a rate change appears in the split of each installment and in the size of the last one, not in what is drafted each month.

superseded_clauses: Enrolling adds the autopay discount to the APR, within the cap and floor of auto_agg_relationship_discount, from the next installment due at least autopay_lead_days calendar days after enrollment; cancelling removes it on the same schedule when autopay_discount_removed_on_cancel is true.
